pilot_record.interpretation: Structural pilot passed; pilot point timings are development observations and not formal performance claims.

timing_protocol.cache_regime: warm repeated execution in one DuckDB process and connection per run
timing_protocol.position_balance: 11 measured rounds cover every order position exactly once per variant and unit
timing_protocol.primary_latency_statistic: median paired within-round log latency ratio
timing_protocol.confidence_interval: 95 percent hierarchical bootstrap over complete seeds and within-seed paired rounds
timing_protocol.set_valued_rule: A candidate is practically dominated by another candidate only when the lower 95 percent confidence bound of their paired latency ratio is greater than 1.03. Otherwise both remain in the non-dominated candidate set.

mechanism_confirmation_questions: Does the key-only plan remain insensitive to the logical wide-column width when sensitive_value is absent from operator metadata?
Does forcing raw materialization introduce a width- and output-cardinality-dependent cost absent from the pruned plan?
Does low Join match rate reduce post-Join Mask work in proportion to matched rows rather than input rows?
At full match, do Mask placement, pipeline breaking, aggregation, and sorting produce different non-dominated candidate sets?
Can every observed latency component be mapped to candidate-specific scan, Join, Mask, materialization, aggregate, or sort work without using a family-specific exception?

required: at least one stable cost contrast is attributable to Mask work rows or bytes
at least one stable cost contrast is attributable to raw or masked materialization work
at least two downstream task groups produce different non-dominated candidate sets
no exact engine-internal byte claim is inferred from logical estimates
feature_contract_authorization.if_authorized: Freeze candidate-specific physical-work features before fitting any Execution-Aware cost model.
feature_contract_authorization.if_not_authorized: Retain the negative mechanism result and do not train the final optimizer.

rejected_actions: change the 3 percent tie band after seeing formal results
select a point winner when the paired interval does not establish practical dominance
drop a seed, width, match rate, task group, or legal candidate because it weakens a contrast
train a residual model on EA-0 before the physical-work feature contract is frozen
describe logical work-byte estimates as DuckDB-measured payload bytes
